name: io.github.malkreide/discover-swiss-mcp
description: Swiss tourism data from discover.swiss Infocenter Open, with per-object licence and attribution

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVER_SWISS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: discover.swiss Infocenter Open subscription key (bring your own key, self-service at portal.discover.swiss). Sent as the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header.

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVER_SWISS_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: discover.swiss project to query. dsod-content is the superset; dsod-hs is the HotellerieSuisse subset.

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVER_SWISS_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport: stdio for local clients, streamable-http for cloud deployments.

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVER_SWISS_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the streamable-http transport. Loopback by default; a non-loopback bind needs an explicit host allow-list.

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVER_SWISS_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port for the streamable-http transport.
